venues.display: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
venues.notes: ICRA is mostly NOT fragmented into per-year OpenAlex sources unlike ISSCC/DAC/IEDM. Only 2022 (S4363607759) is OpenAlex-native (confirmed by direct DOI resolution); all other 2016-2025 years are orphaned in OpenAlex (works exist, ingested via Crossref, but primary_location.source is null - verified via DOI lookup) and are covered via Crossref DOI-prefix validation (10.1109/icra<opt-digits>.<year>.<paper>). S4210217939 is a legit legacy ICRA series source but covers only 2007 (out of window) - kept for completeness/future backfill, unused by current 2016-2025 harvest. REJECTED S4306419799 ('International Conference on Robotics and Automation' catch-all, 698 works spanning 1984-2021, 8-61/yr) as contaminated with unrelated papers - do not use for harvesting; flagged for human review. Rejected lookalikes: ICRAI, AQTR, ICORAS, ICCAR, CCRA, ICMRA, ICARCV, CACRE, ROBOTHIA, ICARA. 2016-2018/2022 volumes run 21-42% below expected_per_year[1200,2000] lower bound but this matches ICRA's real accepted-paper growth over the decade, not a wrong-source signal (identity confirmed via DOI registrant prefix + content sampling). 2026: zero genuine ICRA works found (all apparent hits were the distinct ICRAI lookalike) - not included, unclear if lag or not-yet-held.

venues.notes: Identity confirmed with high confidence: Crossref DOI prefix 10.15607 is registered exactly to 'Robotics: Science and Systems Foundation' (no lookalike ambiguity; Science Robotics and regional robotics symposia checked and excluded). RSS does NOT fragment into per-year OpenAlex sources like IEDM/DAC/ISCA -- it has essentially no usable OpenAlex source at all. Two name-matching sources exist and were both rejected: S4306420803 (conference, 29 stray DOI-less works scattered 2006-2020, ~2% of true output, unusable/double-counting risk) and S4393918458 (journal, correct ISSN 2330-7668, but 0 works attached). All ~1,469 real papers live in OpenAlex only as orphaned records (primary_location.source=null), reachable by DOI, not by source filter. Year coverage 2016-2025 fully confirmed via Crossref with DOI-prefix-verified per-year counts (see years{}), volume within/near expected_per_year [70,170] except 2016 (47, below range but at window edge). 2026 checked, not yet published (0 hits). Set to candidate, not verified, for an affirmative, venue-specific reason (not the 85%-on-native-years technicality, which would just be skipped): Crossref's RSS records have 0% author affiliation strings (unlike IEDM, nothing for normalize_affiliations.py to resolve later), and the only fallback -- OpenAlex's orphaned records -- has only ~45-50% institution coverage, inconsistent per paper (0/N to N/N), the same pattern PLAN.md already tested and rejected project-wide. Institution attribution, this project's core purpose, is not yet solvable for RSS with the current pipeline design. Needs a user decision before harvesting: accept degraded orphaned-record coverage, find a third data source (Semantic Scholar, official RSS site), or exclude RSS pending better data. Full detail in data/reports/rss-2026-07-21.md.
